comment: Recognition layer 2: community signs. Each entry fires a sign popup + narrator line as the car crosses the trigger radius. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space via the route origin+scale. Radius in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm placement.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Junction where the Palisadoes strip meets Windward Road — first major intersection after the airport

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston area along Windward Road

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: East Kingston residential community; Mountain View Avenue is the main road through

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston intersection hub — multiple bus routes converge here

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern commercial and hotel district

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The clock tower marks the centre of this major hub — halfway between Spanish Town and the old city

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: The 6-mile marker on Spanish Town Road — the informal western boundary checkpoint out of Kingston

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital — St. Catherine parish seat; Cathedral of St. James is a V2 landmark candidate

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the famous gorge — Rio Cobre canyon and Flat Bridge ahead

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine town near the Alcan/Windalco alumina plant

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Carry me ackee go a Linstead market — St. Catherine market town

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Small St. Ann town at the crossroads — the climb up begins here

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: The legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre canopy of tree ferns — a natural wonder that shades the road to Ochi

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Ochi — journey's end on the north coast
